title: 24 Top Cycling Teams Are Making A New Money Move To Fix Cycling’s Business Model
content:
Two dozen teams join forces in a new venture to try to create untapped revenue streams to help underwrite today's super team budgets. Can they fix cycling's business model?

Read the full article at 24 Top Cycling Teams Are Making A New Money Move To Fix Cycling’s Business Model on Velo.
